تكتسحن (form VIII)
# تَكْتَسِحْنَ (taktasiḥna) /tak.ta.siħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# تُكْتَسَحْنَ (tuktasaḥna) /tuk.ta.saħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
